# Shodasha Productivity — Track your desktop time and Grow with your habits

> **Shodasha Productivity** is an ultra-fast, local-first Windows 10 & 11 desktop application compiled natively in Rust. It fuses passive desktop time tracking, visual habit heatmaps, and Kanban task management with zero cloud telemetry.

## System Overview & Core Capabilities

- **Tagline**: Track your desktop time and Grow with your habits
- **Operating Systems**: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit x86_64)
- **Primary License**: Open Source (MIT)
- **Release Version**: v0.1.6 (Stable)
- **Windows Setup Installer**: [Shodasha_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe](https://github.com/aditya452007/Shodasha_Productivity/releases/download/v0.1.6/Shodasha_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe)
- **Repository**: [aditya452007/Shodasha_Productivity](https://github.com/aditya452007/Shodasha_Productivity)

## Technical Architecture & Performance Specs

- **Backend Engine**: Native Rust using Win32 API (`GetForegroundWindow()`) for foreground application polling every 30 seconds.
- **Resource Footprint**: Minimal memory consumption (< 15 MB RAM), 0.0% background idle CPU.
- **Local Data Privacy**: 100% offline SQLite database (`%APPDATA%\Shodasha\shodasha.db`). Zero network telemetry or cloud API calls.
- **Habit-Task Sync**: 1-way automated trigger — checking off a daily habit automatically completes its linked Kanban task.

## Key Concepts & Terminology

1. **TimeEntry**: Logged window/app session automatically captured by the Windows activity tracker.
2. **Habit & HabitRecord**: Daily binary check-in (Done / Not Done) with GitHub-style calendar heatmaps and streak counters.
3. **Task & KanbanColumn**: Drag-and-drop task card residing in configurable board columns (To Do, In Progress, Done).
4. **AppCategory**: User-defined classification of applications into Work, Distraction, or Neutral.
